title: Full resync: when starting again is the cheaper option

videos.script:
A delta only works while the server remembers. {{gone}} When the cursor is older than its history, the server says so. Four hundred and ten: Gone.

Then the device starts again. {{snapshot}} It downloads everything into a new file, beside the old one. The screens keep reading the old copy, whole. {{rename}} And one rename makes the new file the database. There is no moment in which half of each can be read.

One thing must survive the swap. {{outbox}} The work the server has not seen yet. The outbox is carried across and applied again, so the session you typed offline is still there, still waiting to be sent.

And the cost, measured. {{cost}} A hundred and fifty kilobytes, against one tombstone. That is why a resync is the exception.
